title: FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit Payment Activity and the Credit Builder Made-Good Relief
content:
The relief share of the made-good relief on a Credit Builder account grows with the number of payments the borrower has made on a Larkspur FlexLine. The payments are read from the borrower's FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit ledger: its payment entries and their dates.

## FlexLine payment count

When 6 or more payments were posted to the borrower's Larkspur FlexLine in the 6 whole calendar months before today (a payment dated today counts, and one dated on the same day of the month 6 months earlier falls outside them), the FlexLine addition for many payments is added; when 3 to 5 were, the FlexLine addition for some payments; when fewer than 3 were, nothing is added for the FlexLine.

| FlexLine payments posted in the 6 months | Added to the relief share |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | FlexLine addition for many payments: 0.1 (10 percentage points) |
| 3 to 5 | FlexLine addition for some payments: 0.05 (5 percentage points) |
| fewer than 3, or no FlexLine | nothing |

## Edge of the 6 months (hypothetical dates)

Today 20 November: a FlexLine payment dated 20 May falls outside the 6 months; one dated 21 May is counted.
